# Skills

AI-ready skills that create and maintain Linear work to the documented
operating model. Install them as a Claude Code plugin, then invoke by name.

```text
/plugin marketplace add dataGriff/linear-work-management
/plugin install linear-work-management@linear-work-management
```

**Prerequisite:** these skills act on your Linear workspace through the **Linear MCP
server** — connect it before using them.

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_skill_index.py — do not edit by hand. -->

| Skill | What it does | Guide |
| ----- | ------------ | ----- |
| [`linear-doctor`](https://github.com/dataGriff/linear-work-management/tree/main/skills/linear-doctor) | Audit a Linear workspace for drift from the Ways of Working operating model. Reports (does not fix) violations of the hard rules — initiatives with no Key Results, projects with no named Key Result, unclassified issues (in no project and no flow/* label, or both), initiatives/projects without a single named owner, and active initiatives or planned-or-later projects with no dates. Use for a health check of the happydevs workspace or before a review. | [hard-rules](../hard-rules.md) |
| [`linear-initiative`](https://github.com/dataGriff/linear-work-management/tree/main/skills/linear-initiative) | Draft or refine a Linear initiative to the Ways of Working standard — a defined outcome with declared Key Results (measured or committed), a single named owner, and a target date set from Planned onward. Coaches the KR table and produces the initiative description ready to create in the happydevs workspace. Use when starting a new initiative or tidying an existing one. | [initiatives](../initiatives.md) |
